units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 21a:12">Ab. Zar. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>ובלבד שלא יעשנה ש׳</he> provided that (in selling dwellings to a gentile) he does not make it a (gentile) settlement; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 21a:12">ib.</cite> <he>אין ש׳ וכ׳</he> a settlement consists of no less than three men (living in a group).
<cite ref="Gittin 6a:17">Gitt. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>מש׳ לש׳</he> when the deed of divorce is carried from one group of buildings to another; Y. ib. I, 43ᶜ top.
Gen. R. s. 39 וממולדתך זו שְׁכוּנָתְךָ ‘and out of thy moledeth’ (Gen. XII, 1) this means, thy settlement.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64:3">Gen. R. s. 64</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01123"><he>נָצִיב</he></cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2:8">Lev. R. s. 2</cite> <he>שכונתי</he> some ed., v. <cite ref="U01153"><he>שְׁכִינָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 68a">B. Mets. 68ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 108b:5">108ᵇ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="M02910"><he>משכנתא</he></cite>) <he>דש׳ גביה</he> the right of preemption (accorded to neighbors) is with him (the mortgagee).—[<cite ref="U01133"><he>שְׁכוּנָה</he></cite> ch., v. next w.]
